title: Yillotooɓe Haawniiɗi e Wuro Koɗki
intro: Fedde ari e dame wuro ngo yimɓe mum meeɗaa anndude goonga. Ɓe ngaddi nelal, kono hoɗɓe ɓee mbayliima, ina mbeltii e fitinaaji. Kono, e nokku mo sikkaano, daande wootere ummii ngam faddaade hoɗdiiɓe ɓee, waɗti dingiral ngam waylude geɗe keewɗe.
clues: En naatii e wuro ngo yimɓe mum njibinaama e keefeeraagal.
Ɓe ƴeewi min e sikkitaare, ɓe mbiyi, ko on tagoore tan no amen nii.
Min njeertinii ɓe, kono ɓe umminii min kaaƴe.
Gorko gooto dogi ummii e damal wuro ɓurngo woɗɗude ngam tabitinde goonga men.
O anndini leñol makko, hol ko haɗi mi rewde tagɗo mi oo?
Yeddude wuro ngoo joofi ko e ɓuuɓri wootiri, silsil laami ɗo ɓe meeɗnoo jeertaade.

arabic: إِذْ أَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَيْهِمُ ٱثْنَيْنِ فَكَذَّبُوهُمَا فَعَزَّزْنَا بِثَالِثٍۢ فَقَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّآ إِلَيْكُم مُّرْسَلُونَ
verse: When We sent to them two but they denied them, so We strengthened [them] with a third, and they said, "Indeed, we are messengers to you." (36:14)
